correctness.rationale: For adjacent edges xy,yz, the local edge distinguishing landmarks in K_m join independent_n are exactly the nonshared endpoints {x,z}: all other vertices are either incident to the common vertex y or at equal distance 1 from both edge sets (check all clique/independent edge-type cases). With m>=2 any unordered vertex pair can be realized as the nonshared endpoints of such edges (including two clique vertices by using an independent common neighbor when m=2), hence R resolves iff |V-R|<=1. With m=1 only leaf pairs occur; R must choose >=n-1 leaves while center optional. For K2 there are no adjacent distinct edges; nonempty-generator convention gives 2z+z^2. Consequently polynomial for m>=2 is z^N+N z^(N-1), and for star n>=2 is z^(n-1)(n+z)(1+z). An independent BFS distance/adjacent edge test of every subset for all 1<=m,n<=4 confirms each branch. Universal claim follows from pair-realization lemma, not finite sampling.
